svg.title: Yellow Relief with Black
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Black upper panel behind a large left-pointing yellow triangle; depth and shadows omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/98.376/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
